summary: Flutter now posts bounded sender samples on Android/macOS/Windows and selected remote receiver samples to the authenticated screen-metrics endpoint, alongside web sender/receiver reporting. Unit/widget coverage, the full Flutter test suite and analyzer pass. Runtime delivery on real peers and parity for renderer-presented FPS remain unverified. The web diagnostics popover flips above when needed and clamps/scrolls within available viewport height.

checks.name: Web sender reporting lifecycle and POST contract
checks.observation: Source review: frontend/src/voice/screen_sender_reporting.ts refreshes sender diagnostics every 2 seconds while SHARING and reports every 5 seconds; state cleanup stops both timers. screen_client_reporter.ts posts JSON with credentials=same-origin to /api/v1/voice/screen-metrics and applies fixed enums and numeric bounds. Reporter and lifecycle tests pass.

checks.name: Web selected receiver reporting lifecycle and POST contract
checks.observation: Source review: ScreenViewer.vue submits receiver reports only for the selected stream and only while the document is visible; use_screen_receiver_diagnostics.ts samples the selected receiver track, resets on track changes, and reports through the same endpoint. Reporter and lifecycle tests pass.

checks.name: Flutter Android and desktop sender payload/platform/cadence
checks.observation: The sender uses android_native on Android and desktop_native on macOS/Windows. AppState starts a sample immediately and every 5 seconds, uses a generation gate, and stops on unpublish/leave/disconnect. Bounded serialization and supported-platform mapping tests pass; the existing API-client test confirms the authenticated same-origin route, Origin and session cookie.

checks.name: Flutter selected receiver reporting and foreground lifecycle
checks.observation: The selected remote receiver sends an anonymous bounded sample every 5 seconds, including waiting_subscription when selected but not subscribed. Local preview and unselected streams are excluded; the widget regression confirms reporting pauses in background and resumes in foreground.

checks.name: Flutter authenticated API client route and headers
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/avatar_api_test.dart --plain-name 'posts anonymous sender metrics with the authenticated origin'
checks.observation: The API client posts JSON to /api/v1/voice/screen-metrics with configured Origin and the existing session cookie; no client identity is added to the report.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite and static analysis
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 298 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Backend strict metrics route, retention and ACL
checks.observation: The endpoint accepts fixed platform/direction/state values and bounded numeric fields, rejects unknown identity fields, retains only fresh anonymous samples, requires a session for POST, and restricts the admin snapshot to administrators. All three Go test packages pass; desktop_native is an allowed platform enum.

checks.name: Web diagnostics popover placement regression
checks.observation: Placement tests cover opening above near the bottom, staying below when it fits, and clamping/scrolling to the roomier side when neither side fits. Component wiring and overflow CSS assertions pass.

checks.name: Web popover viewport behavior in a live browser
checks.observation: The layout calculation, Vue event wiring, and CSS were verified with unit/source tests, but the lower-edge interaction was not visually confirmed in an authenticated browser session.

checks.name: Full frontend tests and production build
checks.command: cd frontend && npm test -- --run && npm run build
checks.observation: All 685 frontend tests pass; vue-tsc and Vite production build pass. Vite reports the existing >500 kB chunk-size advisory.

checks.name: Flutter receiver/sender calculation tests and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_share_metrics_test.dart test/screen_receiver_diagnostics_test.dart && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 11 focused Flutter metrics/diagnostics tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Production/browser and live-peer verification
checks.observation: No live Android/macOS/Windows sender plus two receiver run was performed; metric arrival in the authenticated admin snapshot and native stats availability remain unverified. The browser popover has no live screenshot confirmation. Flutter currently reports decoded FPS but does not provide a verified renderer-presented FPS counter.

privacy: Reported schema contains only bounded numeric samples and fixed platform/direction/state enums. No account, channel, track, IP, token, or media-content fields are included.
remaining: Run live Android/macOS/Windows screen shares with two receivers and verify sender/receiver reports in the authenticated admin snapshot, including stop/restart behavior; determine a trustworthy Flutter renderer-presented FPS source; visually confirm the web popover near the lower viewport edge in a live browser.
